race.comment: DONE MY JOB (1) was too good for a maiden field last start over 1400m at this track, scoring by 1.3 lengths. Sparingly raced and has more to offer with Allen back in the saddle. He should be very hard to hold out late. WILD RUBY (10) doesn't win out of turn, scoring just once from 14 starts but is going quite well this time in and comes back in grade now. Respecting despite a tough gate. NO GREATER VUE (2) struggled at Geelong last time but had been good at Echuca on heavy prior and back slightly in trip should suit although onto synthetic is some query. FLYING JUDE (8) is through the same Geelong race and was just fair but has scope to improve and was good placing here prior.
